subject: Confirm your new email address — M'Arte
preview: Our customer care has started moving your M'Arte account to this address.
heading: Your new email address
message: As you asked, our customer care has started changing the email address of your M'Arte account to this one.
messageSecondary: To finish, please confirm this address using the button below. The link also signs you in to your account.
messageTertiary: Until you confirm, your account keeps its current email address. Once you do, we will let that address know about the change.
highlightBody: We move an account to a new email address only once that address has been confirmed, so that no one else can take control of your account.
expiry: For your security, this link will expire in 60 minutes.
ignore: If you did not ask us to change your email address, please disregard this message — your account will stay as it is.
